comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a damper; pr-270 identifies and replaces the correctly rated fuse in a named DIN-rail holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine adjustment, locking, and iterative cycling. pr-270 requires opening a hinged carrier, extracting and inserting a small cartridge, selecting the correct spare, reclosing, and passing a pull test.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate succeeds through repeatable impact behavior and retained setting. pr-270 requires the KTK-6 seated in F2, the blown fuse in the tray, F2 closed and pull-test secure, while wrong-holder opening or KTK-10 insertion zeros the score.
comparison.reason: Small-part manipulation is shared only generically. Fuse selection/replacement and carrier retention test a different ability from adjustment of damping based on measured motion.
